text: I am very grateful to the dentist for being so patient with someone who is terrified of dentists. The explanations were excellent, and my fear disappeared once I trusted the dentist. I went for treatment for a toothache and asked for a tooth extraction. The dentist said it wasn't decayed, examined it thoroughly to be sure, and ultimately didn't extract it, suggesting it was likely due to another cause. What the dentist said was true; the pain is gone today, and it was due to gingivitis. The dentist did a great job scaling my teeth; even though they said it might cause sensitivity, it wasn't that bad. Their touch was very steady and gentle. I'm no longer afraid. I highly recommend this clinic.

text: I wouldn't even give it one star. The first time I went for a filling, the filling material was high, and the dentist took responsibility and refilled it, but it didn't improve. When I consulted them again, they said my tooth was probably cracked. I asked about preventative treatment, but the dentist said there was nothing to treat. They didn't even bother to X-ray or check the tooth, just suggested a new silver filling. I was already unsure because I'd already had three fillings. I said if the tooth was cracked, I was willing to have it treated, but they said it couldn't be treated and I had to wait for the nerve to be damaged and then have root canal treatment. I really don't understand why I couldn't have it treated if I knew in advance. So I consulted another clinic with a specialist in root canal surgery. That dentist said a crown could actually prevent further cracking. I understand they want to make money, but they should have more professionalism. Your profession is medicine, and you're earning money from people's bodies. If I had believed them and not sought treatment, and waited for the tooth to crack and the root to die, I would have had to have it extracted. It was terrible. Don't use their services. If you lack knowledge or can't give proper advice, don't give incorrect information. Patients see you as a doctor and expect to believe you.
